outcome: renal artery blood flow (pulsatility and resistance index)
cohort: The study included nine fetal growth restricted neonates and seven control neonates, all born at less than 32 weeks of gestation.
finding: FGR neonates showed higher renal tissue oxygen saturation (rSO2) and lower fractional tissue oxygen extraction (FTOE) compared to controls during the first three days after birth.
